title.narrative: Jaffna and Kilinochchi Water Supply Project

description.narrative: The loan will implement a project to provide safe drinking water to the population of the city of Jaffna and its surrounding urban and rural area, estimated to contain 300,000 people, and sanitation facilities to approximately 80,000 people.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Access to safe drinking water in targeted urban areas of the Jaffna Peninsula improved

90% of the water quality tests meet the country standards Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Water quality test has been being carried out by NWSDB to meet the country standard Data Source: Statistical data such as provincial and NWSDB reports

300,000 people, including 20% below poverty line and 50% female, provided with continuous standard water service Achievement: 1300 Progress/Status: Presently, providing water service connections to the people of approximately 32,500 and balance will be covered from Q1, 2026. 4,085 new water connections provided. Data Source: Statistical data such as provincial and NWSDB reports
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: 7.5 km. of roads in Vadamarachchi fisherman's village improved Achievement: 1.5 Progress/Status: 8.5 km. road rehabilitation works are completed. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: At least 30% of whom are women Achievement: 20% Data Source: Project progress reports PPMS and JMC data Actual value: 20%

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: At least 50 NWSDB staff report improved skill in managing and monitoring DBO performance-based contract Achievement: 90 Progress/Status: Design Build Operation performance trainings for PMCIU & O&M/ RSC- (NWSDB) conducted in 23rd October 2023 with the 90 officials comprising 20% of the women participation. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys
Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: 15% are headed by women Achievement: 18% Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys Actual value: 18%

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: 20% are below the poverty line Achievement: 35% Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys Actual value: 35%

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: Farming households have increased awareness of water sharing from Iranamadu Tank Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: 203 awareness programs held with farmers from 2011-2015 with 14,435 participants. Required consultations were carried out with famers at each DS Division and PMCIU level. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: Number of households have increased awareness of water conservation, environmental protection and hygiene Achievement: 1500 Progress/Status: In progress. So far, 122 awareness programs completed with 66% of women participation. (Total Participants - 5,825; Male - 2,226 and Female - 3,599.
5 Awareness program held in 2024 for the school by issuing 60 000 leaflets to covey the house holds through students in the project area.
In-addition, an individual consultant has been recruited under a TA for further awareness programs and to assess the increase in the awareness level. The consultant has conducted awareness sessions in 62 schools, covered 6938 participants (4049 females and 2889 males) including of teachers and students. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys

Output: Headworks at Iranadu Tank Improved Indicator: Capacity of Iranamadu Tank increased to 148.0 million m3 (2010 baseline: 131.4 million m3). Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Tank completed and store the water up to 36 feet during the last rainy season. Data Source: Quarterly project progress report

Output: Water supply infrastructure and service in the Jaffna Peninsula improved Indicator: 60,000 new water meter connections installed with at least 15% of the households headed by be women. Achievement: 1200 Progress/Status: 2,750 water meter connection installed with SWRO water and connection works are on-going. 3,590 water meter connections with available existing water sources.
Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and NWSDB annual report, PPMS and JMC data

Output: Water supply infrastructure and service in the Jaffna Peninsula improved Indicator: 700 km of water mains and distribution pipes installed Achievement: 187 Progress/Status: 700 km of distribution pipes and 195 km of transmission mains pipes were installed. Infilling distribution pipes need to be done to achieve the household connections target of 60,000 HH
Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and NWSDB annual report
Headworks at Iranadu Tank Improved

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: Detailed plan and actions for groundwater and surface water monitoring and rehabilitation in Jaffna developed Achievement: y Progress/Status: WRMC established under chairmanship of GA, Jaffna with relevant stakeholders in 2011 and Technical Committee formed in 2013 and TOR has been prepared. Detailed action plan has been prepared for ground water. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y Actual value: y

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: Monitoring systems for groundwater in the Jaffna Peninsula set up and quarterly report produced Achievement: y Progress/Status: Well mapping for monitoring the ground water in Vallipuram & Manalkadu (Recharging area) is processed by NWSDB (Regional Manager Office - Jaffna) in 2023 & 2024. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y Actual value: y

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: Sanitation safety plans developed for Jaffna Achievement: n Progress/Status: Main scope was dropped from the project. But the basic information for the safe sanitation plan disseminated to the public-by-Public Awareness and communication expert. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y Actual value: n

Output: Water resource management systems and capacity strengthened Indicator: Water resource management plan for Iranamadu Tank completed Achievement: n Progress/Status: Irrigation Department informed that the water resource Managment plan report is not required as the water not share for the drinking to Jaffna peninsula. No further actions needed. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and surveys Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y Actual value: n

Output: Water supply infrastructure and service in the Jaffna Peninsula improved Indicator: Desalination plant of 24,000 m3 per day using DBO model installed Achievement: 95% Progress/Status: Due to change in water source, the planned water treatment plant (WTP) plant was replaced with a 24 MLD capacity Sea Water Reverse Osmosis Desalination Plant (SWRO DP), DBO contract. The contract has been awarded in 25th January 2021 and the construction works completed (Sept 2024). Operation service commenced in oct 2024.. The Supply and Laying Water Distribution Network (SLWDN) contract was also signed in Q1 2021 and 94% of the laying works are completed. The project management and supervision consultant (PMSC) and Environmental Monitoring Consultant (EMC) contracts were awarded in Q3 2021 and PMSC on going and EMC completed.
Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and NWSDB annual report Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y Actual value: 95%

Output: Water supply infrastructure and service in the Jaffna Peninsula improved Indicator: O&M part of the desalination plant contract implemented for 5 years Achievement: n Progress/Status: Operation service commenced in oct 2024. Data Source: Quarterly project progress reports and NWSDB annual report Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y Actual value: n
